snippet.title: Bracer - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Grab a buddy and brace for chaos in this 3D Fantasy Shoot ‘Em Up (SHMUP). Face off against a twisted necromancer fueled by a cursed bracer and a bloodlust for destruction. Blast enemies, dodge projectiles, unlock upgrades, and customize your hero with unique weapons, skills, and skins.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4394480/Bracer/

Developer: Curious Fate
